QuestInfo.name: [Maple Castle] The Grand Invitation
QuestInfo.0: Cygnus and other people of Maple World have decorated the old #bMaple Castle#k for a magnificent party.
QuestInfo.1: Click on the #i3800418#Halloween notice #r"Come to Maple Castle"#k on your left to get to #bMaple Castle#k. Cygnus is waiting for you there.
QuestInfo.2: You met Cygnus, decked out in her lovely costume, at #bMaple Castle#k.

0.0: Hey, #b#h0##k! I bet you want to know all about spooky #bMaple Castle#k, right?

yes.0: Of course you do! Okay, there's this ancient castle called #bMaple Castle#k, and it only opens up at night. But...no one lives there! Ooh, spoooooky!
yes.1: The thing is, #bCygnus#k decided that #bMaple Castle#k would make an awesome place for a party! Seriously, she went all-out. You gotta see it!
yes.2: Give my regards to #rCygnus in Maple Castle for me.
yes.3: To get to #bMaple Castle#k, just click on the #i3800418##bHalloween notice at the top left#k. Sigh... I wish I could go, but I have some stuff to take care of. Have fun for me!

no.0: Oh...really? But...it's all spooky and stuff...
